scope: Approximate local four-metric evaluation; span threshold, entity strategy and association threshold frozen from development fold 0, with no parameter selection on this fold. The checkpoint and complete pipeline still involve development selection; NOT independent test performance.

baseline_span_metrics.scope: Exact original-character spans, positive/NO; all gold spans retained in recall; no HPO or patient scores

selected_common_span_threshold.selection: Frozen from development fold 0; no current-fold threshold search

metrics.scope: Exact original-character spans, positive/NO; all gold spans retained in recall; no HPO or patient scores

span_threshold_objective: No optimization on this fold; evaluate the frozen development-fold-0 span threshold
span_label_arbitration: Linked entities retain one label per extent; highest passing raw score wins, positive on ties
selection_rule: No optimization on this fold; evaluate the single frozen entity strategy and association threshold

approximations: No official scorer is supplied; these are local implementations of the published metrics.
Main-text filtering excludes explicitly labelled reference/back-matter passages. Titles, abstracts, figures and tables remain eligible because they contain training labels.
A gold -1 mention matches one prediction at its exact span regardless of predicted ID. Document-level -1 is one concept bucket per document; official handling is unspecified.
Compound HPO strings are split for both entity and association scoring; unmapped association text is compared exactly, including case.
Only NO denotes negation. Other gold notes, including D, remain positive. Gold IDs are evaluated as supplied without ontology repair.
Zero denominators yield zero except a patient's two empty phenotype sets, whose precision, recall and F1 are all one as specified by the competition.
